name: Mikage
source:
Founder and current commissioner of Yonomori. He has a hands-on approach, and therefore goes out to investigate and defeat demons with the best members of the Special Division 1.

[Translated from [url=http://lovedelivery.biz/suito/chara.html]the official website[/url].]
